intro: Lieutenant Doren calls upon you to deliver the final strike against Colonel Kurzen and his inner guard. You are sent into the Stockpile to eliminate the rogue commander and his remaining leaders to secure the Rebel Camp's survival.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You have proven yourself time and again, and your resourcefulness seems to rival even that of Kurzen himself. You may be the salvation of our band of rebels...if you can pit yourself against Kurzen and prevail!
He commands his men from deep within the Stockpile. You must enter that cave, brave through his defenders, and face Kurzen and his leaders.
Farewell, friend. My hope, and the fate of my men, go with you.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Dare I hope that Kurzen and his defenders are dead, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: I dared not believe the reports, but you bring us proof that...Kurzen and his leaders are defeated. You have saved us!
These jungles are filled with menaces of all types, but none had the cruel intellect of Kurzen. We may all breathe easier now that he is gone.
